episodes.synopsis: Three complete strangers were selected to compete in the Biz Game. The three of them don't get along at all, but have to work together to earn the prize of 1 billion dollars, which all three of them need.
episodes.title: AAA (No Name)

episodes.synopsis: Team AAA (No Name) won their first match. In the next match, they're the home team, and they have to plan and learn to co-operate if they have any hope of winning.
